project_option: Project 2 — Opportunity Registry and Pathway Platform
verification_status: Local static and regression suite passed 29/29 checks and the frontend build passed. The additive R4 migration was applied to the deployed Supabase database; deployed backend health, public discovery, and authenticated R4 health/run smoke endpoints returned HTTP 200. The mutation-enabled fixture sequence was intentionally not run against shared production data.

sync_trigger.operator_ui: Sign in as the staff operator and select Run Mitacs fixture v1 or v2 in External-source operations.
sync_trigger.api: POST /api/external-sync with {"fixture":"v1"} or {"fixture":"v2"}; server-side operator authorization is required.
sync_trigger.failure_simulation: POST /api/external-sync with {"simulate_failure":true}; the endpoint returns an error after recording failure health, without changing external opportunity data.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R4-01 to R4-06: external provenance and handoff
checks.expected_behavior: Records identify their named provider, show a safe authoritative link, and say the provider controls eligibility, application, and outcome.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R4-08 to R4-12: v1 then v2 sync classification
checks.setup: Run v1 first, then v2 from the supplied fixture bundle.
checks.expected_behavior: v2 reports MX-1005 new, MX-1001/MX-1004 unchanged, MX-1002 changed, MX-1003 not seen, and one malformed record skipped.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R4-10 to R4-14: disappearance, failure safety, freshness, and health
checks.entry_point: External cards and operator health surface
checks.expected_behavior: MX-1003 retains last-known content and is labelled not seen; a simulated failure changes no record state and exposes a failure reason only to the operator.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R4-15 to R4-20: local faculty support survives source changes (chosen challenge)
checks.setup: Record support on MX-1002 before v2; for the chosen challenge record support on MX-1003 before it disappears and reappears.
checks.expected_behavior: Support remains separate from source-controlled fields and survives change, disappearance, and reappearance without implying provider endorsement.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R4-25 to R4-27: external timing, authorization, and regression
checks.role: public visitor, ordinary student, verified faculty, and operator
checks.expected_behavior: External records are not expired by Algoma timing; non-operators cannot trigger or inspect sync health; prior release workflows continue to work.

fixture_setup: Use a disposable or evaluator-controlled database. For a fresh database, apply schema.sql, then run node backend/seed-r1.js, npm --prefix backend run seed:r2, and npm --prefix backend run seed:r3. For an existing R1–R3 database, apply r4_migration.sql. Run R4 QA only with a reset plan; never run mutation-enabled fixture checks against shared production data.
test_access: Use instructor-approved passwordless test-mode accounts. The R3 fixture includes r3.staff@algomau.ca as operator and the linked R3 faculty accounts. Do not commit passwords, tokens, challenge codes, or database credentials.
